summary: Router 0.32.2 (#162): poll_node drops its answer, and does not count a failed poll as a miss, when the agent's OLLAMA report (frame over the authenticated tunnel, apply_ollama_push) arrived after the poll began. Before, a poll answer that came back after the agent's first report replaced the reported model list until the next report. No route, configuration, protocol, payload or agent change; the agent's report already was the authority while fresh (no polling then). CI gains one self-test run.

findings.evidence: The change gives an agent report precedence over a concurrent router poll of the same node. Reports only arrive over the node's own authenticated tunnel (approved key); a node can already set its own model list through that report today. A compromised agent gains nothing new: it could suppress its node's poll answers, which it controls anyway since the poll also goes through its tunnel.
findings.resolution: No new capability for an agent; the trust boundary of node-reported state is unchanged.

findings.evidence: ci.yml adds `python test/selftest_poll_yields_to_push.py` to the existing test job; no new action, permission, secret or trigger.
findings.resolution: No change to CI trust; the test runs without network, router process or credentials.

tests.evidence: all PASS (7 checks); with poll.py from origin/main 3 checks fail and the standby's model carries an openai: digest (the observed state reproduced).
exit code 0, 332 PASS lines, no FAIL.

tests.command: ruff check .; python test/check_adr_index.py; python test/selftest_control_flow.py; python test/check_control_flow.py; python test/selftest_english_names.py
tests.evidence: All checks passed; ADR index ok: 97 ADRs; control flow ok: 0 legacy findings.

limitations: The race is reconstructed from timing in the journal (failure 26 s after the tunnel connected, model back 36 s after, both within one 30 s report interval) and reproduced in the self-test; it is confirmed in operation by the journal line `poll answer dropped` after the next router restart.
